- main:
  - paragraph:
    - strong: "Submission Type:"
  - paragraph:
    - strong: A complaint is a specific written expression of dissatisfaction concerning a difficulty or problem which the person experienced when using or attempting to use an airline’s services. Complaints will be sent to the airline and/or ticket agent that is the subject of the complaint.
  - paragraph: A comment is a remark regarding air transportation expressing an opinion. This information will be recorded in our database, but no further action is required by the airline and/or ticket agent.
  - paragraph: A compliment is a submission regarding a positive experience. This information will be recorded in our database, but no further action is required by the airline and/or ticket agent.

    - radio "Complaint" [checked]
    - text: Complaint
    - radio "Comment/Opinion"
    - text: Comment/Opinion
    - radio "Compliment"
    - text: Compliment
